source.base_materialization: Current v11 sources were preserved as the starting point, and the GitHub main ref was checked before research. The v12 release commit is recorded in README_BUNDLE.md.

scope.primary_heart: Anticanonical heart qgr R_e; only AS heart is used as a comparison heart.
scope.first_forgetting: All standard Euler-type Q full very strong AOU markings in the maximal weak-compatible AS/anticanonical domain. On a root-free fixed weak heart their nine objects are automatically line objects. The proof open U is not used to truncate the source fiber; no conclusion for other OU Euler types or the entire GIT boundary.
scope.second_forgetting: Raw line choices are Lambda on very-general fibers of the actual standard AOU relation torus. Exact-equivalence-class fibers are Lambda/ZK because the exact autoequivalence numerical image is ZK. This is a statement about natural numerical labels, not abstract countable cardinality.
scope.groupoids_and_stacks: Deferred as a research priority until after set-theoretic classification; retained conditional formal comparisons are not a global stack theorem.
scope.line_reconstruction: Uses the known Artin-Zhang reconstruction theorem under its hypotheses, without asserting a new general reconstruction theorem.

mathematical_status.intrinsic_and_numerical_criterion: Retained complete proofs: End=C, self Ext2=0, exceptionality iff defect n=0; rank-one torsion-free alone is insufficient. Weak axioms plus all-object RR/H and r(O0)=1 give Serre vanishing, A1={r=0}, positivity and c1 uniqueness. On the actual central elliptic-divisor locus, A0={r=d=0} is now proved; the abstract weak-heart converse without a central divisor remains open.
mathematical_status.admissibility_test: Proved: a finite epimorphism from negative H-twists of L to O0 plus all nonnegative self-twist higher-Ext vanishings is equivalent to weak admissibility.
mathematical_status.root_reflection: Conditional on a degree-zero root simple T=(0,C,s): Hom/Ext dichotomy, actual affine reflection D -> D-(s-D.C)C on line objects, preservation of section rings and strict admissible halfspace. No such root simple is constructed or excluded under the unconditional axioms.
mathematical_status.weyl_realization: Proved under (R0), the absence of degree-zero root simples: the cross-block monad realizes the missing simple reflection, giving a W(E6)-torsor whenever the specified line-marking set is nonempty. The proof checks exactness, line type, fullness and very strongness.
mathematical_status.helix_reconstruction: Proved: one AZ-ample residue in a full very strong helix gives ampleness of the entire helix, right noetherianity and exact reconstruction of the fixed anticanonical heart. OU AS-Gorenstein/finite-gldim input and RR growth yield AS regularity; the actual global dimension is 3.
mathematical_status.aou_resolution: Retained: under (R0), finite End has 18 arrows and nine full-support quadratic relations; Keller completion/Ginzburg resolution give the AOU cubic simple resolution. New helix recognition proves the converse for every standard full very strong thread with admissible leading line in the fixed root-free weak anticanonical heart.
mathematical_status.generic_line_existence: Full algebraic-family proof retained and its domain weakened explicitly: relative finite/perfect data on all B, weak hearts only on a dense open U and at the classical point b0 (b0 need not lie in U). All needed inputs now verified for the actual standard AOU relation torus; very generally Line_adm=Line=Lambda and each standard full very strong marking set is a nonempty W torsor.
mathematical_status.affine_aut_and_actual_fibers: Proved in the full-line-marking setting: exact autoequivalences have affine numerical image Gamma in Lambda semidirect W(E6), containing central ZK. Actual fibers are Gamma_L\W and (Lambda/ZK)/barGamma.
mathematical_status.generic_aut_equalizers: Finite relation equality-locus proof retained. Actual standard AOU torus meets all inputs: a classical Aut(X)=1 point and a Poisson tangent with integer obstruction kernel ZK, via the KS isomorphism. Thus Gamma=ZK very generally and actual fibers are W(E6)-torsor and Lambda/ZK in the maximal weak-compatible standard domain.
mathematical_status.artin_actual_fibers: For the specified admissible relative Artin hearts and line/marking lifts, Aut(X)=1 plus a dual-number quotient with Picard obstruction kernel ZK gives specialization image exactly ZK in all Artin orders. Compatible formal towers have the same orbit sets. No effectivity or arbitrary fraction-field autoequivalence classification is asserted.
mathematical_status.preserved_results: Current commutative/formal comparisons, first-order Picard obstruction/integer-kernel/invariant proofs, universal finite algebra and HH/Serre calculations remain in the manuscript with their hypotheses.
mathematical_status.novelty: The additional deductions are written and reviewed as specified, but exhaustive priority/novelty review, external refereeing and proof-assistant formalization have not been completed.
mathematical_status.remaining_core: Special root-simple loci (now confined to invertible central action on the elliptic-divisor locus), partial admissible class sets, maximal weak-compatible locus and boundaries, algebraicity/regularity of marking changes, precise novelty comparisons. General weak-heart A0->d=0 without a central divisor and arbitrary other OU types/GIT boundary are not resolved.
mathematical_status.right_tail_recognition: New complete proof and independent audits: r(E)=1, End(E)=C and eventual Ext1(E,H^n L)=0 imply torsion-free under (R0). The torsion part has nonnegative right-tail Euler polynomial with slope -d(T), forcing d(T)=0; point positivity and simplicity then rule it out. Standard helix heart membership and rank one are recognized separately, without assuming line objects.
mathematical_status.actual_aou_heart: New complete construction on a nonempty open U in the actual eight-dimensional standard relation torus: OU natural transformation yields a central regular degree-one element with elliptic Hom-algebra quotient; noetherianity lifts; a cofinite corner condition is open around a classical point; MM Cor4.13/Thm4.14 and Amiot Thm2.3 supply ordinary Db(qgr) and shift comparison. Direct AZ and curve-witness rank recognition establish all weak axioms. Surface hearts used are only AS and anticanonical.
mathematical_status.filtration_and_roots: On the central elliptic-divisor locus, A0={r=d=0}, A1={r=0}, A2=A, and rank equals length in A/A1. Central-divisor-annihilated simple objects have ch=(0,0,1); a root-type simple must have invertible central action because its rigidity contradicts the inherited nonzero curve self Ext1. No root simple example is constructed.
